title: A debounced search
description:
Simulate a search box that only searches when the user stops typing.

```
typing "j"... "ja"... "jav"... "java"
searching for "java"
results: JavaScript, Java
typing "p"... "py"
searching for "py"
results: Python
```
hints: Keep one timer id in the closure: every call does `clearTimeout(id)` and starts a new `setTimeout` (lesson 4.05).
requirements: `debounce(fn, ms)` returns a function that calls `fn` with the latest arguments only once `ms` have passed with no new call.
Simulate the keystrokes with `setTimeout` at the times in the starter; search a list of languages, ignoring case.
An old search must never print after a newer one has started (keep a counter of searches).
stretch: Make the search itself async (it takes a random 50 to 300 ms) and drop results from a search that is no longer the newest.
